common.page-description: Full-stack engineer in Kumamoto, Japan. Physics degree, NASA data, two years teaching in Japanese high schools — now building bilingual products.

hero.name: Matt Kurtti
hero.bio: Full-stack engineer at NekkoLabs. Physics degree, a summer of NASA data, two years teaching in Japanese high schools — now building products that have to work in English and Japanese.
hero.image-alt: Matt Kurtti playing trumpet with a Latin jazz band in Kumamoto

findadoc.title: Find a Doc, Japan
findadoc.description: A non-profit helping foreigners in Japan find healthcare in the language they need. I built authentication and profile management, and expanded the medical specialty database to full multilingual support across nine languages.

personal-website.title: This site
personal-website.description: Where I keep my background and my work, and where I try things out. Bilingual from the ground up rather than translated after the fact.

nekkolabs.description: Led full-stack development of a contract-management SaaS, including an AI-powered import wizard with drag-and-drop column mapping and Gemini Flash 2.5 PDF extraction. Built the product's Azure analytics and monitoring stack — Application Insights, structured logging, user-flow Sankey dashboards — plus PII scan/scrub and smoke tests.

findadoc.role: Software Engineer · Find a Doc, Japan
findadoc.description: Engineered authentication and profile management, and expanded the medical specialty database to support nine-plus languages. Worked async with senior engineers, designers and medical professionals across weekly standups and Slack.

amazon.description: Built the safety team's metrics analysis and reporting, and started a safety school for onboarding new hires. First job where the tooling I wrote was the point.

jet.description: Taught English and science at Kumamoto Kita High School, and started a global science course so students could learn science in English. Two years of explaining hard things simply, in two languages.

capstone.description: A Monte Carlo simulation in Java extending the standard hard-sphere model with crowder–crowder interactions, analysed in Python. Found that those interactions significantly change the shape distribution of biopolymers.

nasa.description: Analysed Ion and Electron Sensor measurements from the Rosetta mission in Python, and presented the results as a poster.

music.title: Trumpet
music.blurb: I play Latin and jazz trumpet around Kumamoto. It is the other thing I practise deliberately, and the reason a lot of my Japanese got good.
